L070 gives a complete corrected recovery of the fixed twelve-page article
on two atlases of abstract chiral polytopes. Its sixteen complete manuscripts
form a 41-page volume including a four-page synthesis. All 46 source clauses
have explicit dispositions. The first atlas has 56 examples, with arbitrary
cores retained; Table 1 names and the stated vertex figures are certified.
The second atlas has 79 named groups and 88 printed occurrences, with corrected
totals 9,210 regular and 16,974 oriented chiral classes. Source orders, Aut-group
names and historical conventions are joined explicitly. The larger printed
domain omits $\mathrm{Sp}_4(4)$; no polytope census for that omitted group or
historical program execution is inferred. Classical and software inputs
remain explicit. No new measurement, question answer, principal refutation
or Lean declaration is added.
